author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Fix `EvFDaqDirector` for hostnames over 32 characters.
The call to `gethostname()` will fail with `ENAMETOOLONG` if the host name is longer than 32 characters.
Extend the buffer to `HOST_NAME_MAX + 1` characters to allow for all supported host names and the terminating NUL character.

#### PR validation:

Tested on a host with a name longer than 32 characters.

#### Backport status

May be backported to 17.0.x, just in case.
title: Fix `EvFDaqDirector` for hostnames over 32 characters
